new_destinations.name: Taizhou
new_destinations.coordinates_source: proxy: Taizhou Museum, Jiaojiang (Wikipedia); city-centre point to be resolved from an OSM place=city node
new_destinations.name_evidence: English Wikivoyage has a page "Taizhou (Zhejiang)" listing See/Do entries; the prefecture-level city of Jiaojiang, Huangyan and Luqiao.
new_destinations.reason: Four kept places (Taizhou Museum, Ocean World, Jiufeng Mountain, Fonte Wild Mainland) inside the urban area (Fonte ~21 km, Jiufeng ~13 km from centre, within 75% of a 60 km span). Zhejiang's Taizhou, not Jiangsu's. Rank 5: local hub.

spots.name: Taizhou Museum
spots.bio: Free prefecture museum in Jiaojiang covering the history and culture of the Taizhou area.
spots.reason: Spot of Taizhou: in the Jiaojiang/Huangyan/Luqiao urban area, within Taizhou's span. Judge: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage See listing (hours, free entry); open prefecture museum, an hour's visit.

spots.name: Taizhou Ocean World
spots.bio: Large Jiaojiang aquarium with more than 10,000 sea creatures and daily seal and mermaid shows.

coordinates_hint.source: OSM feature (Nominatim/Overpass, name match): 台州海洋世界 aquarium node
coordinates_hint.note: unverified Nominatim/OSM name match, not a pin

spots.reason: Spot of Taizhou: in the Jiaojiang/Huangyan/Luqiao urban area, within Taizhou's span. Judge: Wikivoyage See listing plus travelchinaguide 'Sea World'; permanent aquarium, multi-hour visit, paid.

spots.name: Jiufeng Mountain
spots.bio: Huangyan hill climbed by stone steps past temples to views over the district, a half-day walk.

coordinates_hint.source: OSM feature (Nominatim/Overpass, name match): 九峰公园（北门） attraction node
coordinates_hint.note: unverified Nominatim/OSM name match, not a pin

spots.reason: Spot of Taizhou: in the Jiaojiang/Huangyan/Luqiao urban area, within Taizhou's span. Judge: Wikivoyage Do names the Huangyan climb: stone steps, temples, a vegetarian temple restaurant and views; half-day hike.

spots.name: Fonte Wild Mainland
spots.bio: Animation-themed Fantawild theme park in the Taizhou Bay New District at Luqiao, opened 2022.

coordinates_hint.source: OSM feature (Nominatim/Overpass, name match): 台州方特•狂野大陆 theme_park way
coordinates_hint.note: unverified Nominatim/OSM name match, not a pin

spots.reason: Spot of Taizhou: in the Jiaojiang/Huangyan/Luqiao urban area, within Taizhou's span. Judge: Wikivoyage See listing; permanent theme park open daily (rule 2, 4).

spots.name: Tiantai Mountain
spots.bio: National 5A scenic area of a box-shaped syncline mountain in Tiantai County, the range that gave Taizhou its name.

coordinates_hint.source: OSM feature (Nominatim/Overpass, name match): Tiantai Mountain Shiliang Scenic Area ticket way
coordinates_hint.note: unverified Nominatim/OSM name match, not a pin

spots.reason: Standalone: only two kept places (this and Guoqing Temple) in the Tiantai area, since its sub-sights (Fangguang, Gaoming, Huading, Qiongtai) are in review; under the four-spot bar. No Wikivoyage Tiantai page. Nearest destination Taizhou is ~70 km away. Judge: Wikivoyage See and travelchinaguide: national 5A box-syncline mountain scenic area, giving Taizhou its name. Wikivoyage geo (30.13,120.65) is wrong; the 29.271,121.054 point is plausible.

spots.name: Guoqing Temple
spots.bio: Birthplace of Tiantai Buddhism, a working temple of about 1,400 years with a Sui-era pagoda and free entry.
spots.reason: Standalone: in the Tiantai area, with Tiantai Mountain as its only kept neighbour (two places never make a destination). Taizhou is ~70 km away. Judge: Wikivoyage lists it twice; birthplace of Tiantai Buddhism, 1,400-year-old working temple with free entry.

spots.name: Shenxianju
spots.bio: 5A scenic area of rock pillars and waterfalls in Xianju County, with the glass Ruyi Bridge.
spots.reason: Standalone: Xianju County, ~80 km west of Taizhou city, with no other kept place nearby. Shown as Shenxianju (the scenic area), not a national park in the legal sense. Judge: Wikivoyage See (Shenxianju scenic area) and travelchinaguide: 5A area of rock pillars, waterfalls and the glass Ruyi bridge.

spots.name: Linhai Ancient City Wall
spots.bio: Ridge-top Southern Great Wall of the Taizhou Fu walled city in Linhai, with a museum and visitor centre.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM feature (Nominatim/Overpass, name match): 台州府城文化旅游区 way (Wikipedia coordinates are misplaced at 120.1 E); judge confirmed 28.85,121.11
spots.reason: Standalone: Linhai is a separate county-level city ~36 km from Jiaojiang, outside the Taizhou urban area, and visitors treat the Fucheng zone as its own trip. Only Ziyang Old Street sits beside it; Taozhu and Dongji are 50 km away, and Linhai has no Wikivoyage page, so no Linhai destination. Judge: 2 counted sources, 2352 page views

spots.name: Ziyang Old Street
spots.bio: The 1,080 m best-preserved ancient street in Linhai, lined with old shops, a national tourism and leisure street.
spots.reason: Standalone beside Linhai Ancient City Wall in the Fucheng zone; two places never make a destination. Linhai is outside Taizhou urban bounds. Judge: China Daily dedicated page: 1,080 m best-preserved ancient street with old shops; Wikivoyage Fucheng entry mentions it; named a national tourism and leisure street. Sources: https://regional.chinadail

spots.name: Taozhu Ancient City
spots.bio: Best-preserved Ming anti-pirate guard town in the Taozhu scenic area, about 50 km east of Linhai.

coordinates_hint.source: OSM feature (Nominatim/Overpass, name match): 桃渚城 attraction way
coordinates_hint.note: unverified Nominatim/OSM name match, not a pin

spots.reason: Standalone: ~50 km east of Linhai on the coast, outside any destination. Judge: China Daily Zhejiang 'Taozhu Scenic Spot' page and travelchinaguide name Taozhu Ancient City (best-preserved Ming anti-pirate guard city) in Linhai geopark; two counted sources. Real name Taozhu.

spots.name: Dongji Islands
spots.bio: Boat-only archipelago of more than 50 islets off Linhai, known for sunrise views and a cobble beach.

coordinates_hint.source: OSM feature (Nominatim/Overpass, name match): 东矶岛 island way
coordinates_hint.note: unverified Nominatim/OSM name match, not a pin

spots.reason: Standalone: offshore islands reached by boat from Linhai; far from any destination. Judge: China Daily Zhejiang (2020 and 2021 islands features) names Dongji: 50+ islets, sunrise and cobble beach in Linhai.

spots.name: Dachen Islands
spots.bio: Ferry-reached island group 52 km off Taizhou with marine landforms, a sea-god temple and Red-tourism sites.

coordinates_hint.source: OSM feature (Nominatim/Overpass, name match): Dachen Islands archipelago node
coordinates_hint.note: unverified Nominatim/OSM name match, not a pin

spots.reason: Standalone: 52 km offshore, far outside Taizhou urban bounds and span; reached by ferry. Judge: Wikivoyage, two China Daily Zhejiang pages and travelchinaguide name it: islands 52 km off Taizhou with marine landforms, sea-god temple and Red-tourism sites.

spots.name: Changyu Dongtian
spots.bio: 4A quarry-cave scenic area in Wenling with a rock cave concert hall and a stone museum.
spots.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing geo (Wenling Changyu Dongtian listing)
spots.reason: Standalone: Wenling, ~26 km south of Jiaojiang, outside Taizhou urban bounds; Wenling has no Wikivoyage page and its kept places (Changyu, Shitang, Shepan) are 40+ km apart, so no Wenling destination. Judge: Wikivoyage See plus travelchinaguide: 4A quarry-cave scenic area with Asia's only rock cave concert hall and stone museum.

spots.name: Shitang Fishing Village
spots.bio: Wenling stone-house fishing village on the Shitang peninsula, with murals, sea views and homestays.
spots.reason: Standalone: Wenling coast, far from Taizhou city and from the other Wenling places. Judge: China Daily 'Enchanting islands in Taizhou' and travelchinaguide ('Shitang Fishing Village') name the Wenling stone-house village with murals and sea views; homestays. Sources: https://regional.chinad

spots.name: Shepan Island
spots.bio: Taizhou's second-largest island, called the island of a thousand caves for its 1,300 quarry caves.
spots.reason: Standalone: island reached by a 20-minute ferry from Liuao, outside any destination. Judge: China Daily dedicated page and travelchinaguide: Taizhou's second-largest island, 'island of a thousand caves' (1,300 quarry caves), 20-min ferry from Liuao. Sources: https://regional.chinadaily.com.c

spots.name: Fangshan Global Geopark
spots.bio: UNESCO global geopark of rock formations and walking trails on the Yuhuan and Wenling border.

coordinates_hint.source: OSM feature (Nominatim/Overpass, name match): Fangshan UNESCO Global Geopark leisure=park way
coordinates_hint.note: unverified Nominatim/OSM name match, not a pin

spots.reason: Standalone: ~18 km from the proposed Yandang Mountains centre (Wenzhou run) and outside its 75% reach (~11 km), so not its spot; Taizhou is ~25 km north, outside its urban bounds. Name and point need checking. Judge: travelchinaguide names Fangshan-Nansong Mountain Scenic Area (Fangshan, Lion Peak, Longjiangmen) linked to Yandang; kept as the single Fangshan-Nansong entry.

spots.name: Dalu Island
spots.bio: 4A forested island off Yuhuan with rock sculpture landscapes, reached by ferry from Kanmen.
spots.reason: Standalone: Yuhuan has a Wikivoyage page but only three kept places here (Dalu, Dongsha, Baima Ao), under the four-spot bar; Yuhuan is ~55 km from Taizhou city. Judge: Wikivoyage, China Daily and travelchinaguide name it: 4A forested island with rock sculpture landscapes, ferry from Kanmen.

spots.name: Dongsha Fishing Village
spots.bio: Preserved fishing village at Kanmen, a provincial historic village with seafood and a lighthouse.
spots.reason: Standalone: one of three kept Yuhuan places; see Dalu Island. Judge: Wikivoyage: preserved fishing village at Kanmen, 3A, provincial historic village with seafood and Pu'an lighthouse.

spots.name: Baima Ao Beach
spots.bio: Sandy 3A beach at Ganjiang town in Yuhuan, a second-tier seaside stop.
spots.reason: Standalone: one of three kept Yuhuan places; see Dalu Island. Beach pin needs OSM natural/beach. Judge: Wikivoyage names the 3A sandy beach at Ganjiang; second-tier beach.

spots.name: Wu Zixiong Glass Art Museum
spots.bio: 10,000 sq m museum of about 10,000 glass artworks, listed among Taizhou's top ten attractions.
spots.reason: Standalone provisionally: location unconfirmed (no coordinates); if the pin lands inside Taizhou urban bounds it becomes taizhou-5. Judge: China Daily dedicated page and travelchinaguide ('Wu Zixiong Glass Art Exhibition Hall'): 10,000 sq m, about 10,000 glass artworks, one of Taizhou's top 10 attractions, 1-2 hr visit, entry about 30 yu

review.name: Taizhou Confucian Temple
review.case: For: a historic temple complex beside the Fucheng wall area that visitors walk to. Against: no counted See listing, may be part of the Fucheng zone.
review.judge_reason: Expedia lists 'Linhai the Confucius Temple', a blog and Wikivoyage photo caption name it; no counted See listing.

review.name: China Citrus Expo Park
review.case: For: permanent themed park with a visitor exhibition. Against: farm-style park, one official feature, rural.
review.judge_reason: 2nd search: China Daily Taizhou feature 'A fruitful adventure awaits you in Taizhou' (2023) and Ctrip list the Huangyan expo park (180 citrus varieties, sculpture, picking, open all year); orange festival is only one season.

review.name: Linghu Park
review.case: For: guide-named lakeside stop. Against: ordinary city park, which COVERAGE rejects as a suburban park.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage Do names Linghu and East Lake as the two large parks for a lake walk and boating; one source, city park.

review.name: Qiongtai Xian Valley
review.case: For: genuine Tiantai scenic valley with cliffs and a legend-rich setting. Against: possibly part of Tiantai Mountain scenic area; unverified.
review.judge_reason: Qiongtai Xiangu is a Tiantai Mountain sight on the Chinese Wikipedia list; no counted visitor source found in a quick search.

review.name: Kuocang Mountain
review.case: For: whole-range hiking and viewpoints. Against: a range not a single place, no counted source.
review.judge_reason: Range in Linhai/Xianju with wind farm and Shenxianju linkage; no counted source found, widely known to hikers and drivers.

review.name: Yijiangshan Island
review.case: For: historic site next to Dachen. Against: access and public opening unclear; coordinates (28.608,121.8135) look plausible for the island.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage-level mention only; site of the 1955 battle with memorial; no counted visitor source found and access (military island) unverified.

review.name: Fangguang Temple
review.case: For: significant temple in the scenic area. Against: part of Tiantai Mountain and a single thin source.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage lists it as a national key temple on Mount Tiantai; one source, no description of what to see.

review.name: Gaoming Temple
review.case: For: historic Tiantai temple near Guoqing. Against: nothing in visitor sources describes it.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage listing with no description; Wikipedia lists it; nothing says what to see.

review.name: Huading Mountain
review.case: For: a named summit with views. Against: part of Tiantai Mountain scenic area and festival-linked.
review.judge_reason: Highest peak of the Tiantai range and part of the scenic area; Wikivoyage mentions it only for the cuckoo azalea festival.

review.name: East Lake, Linhai
review.case: For: lake and old streets are distinct from the wall. Against: part of the Fucheng cultural tourism zone.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage prices East Lake in the Fucheng zone ticket with boats and walking; also a China Daily mention of the ancient-city zone.

review.name: Linhai Museum
review.case: For: free, guide-listed. Against: a local museum with 0 views.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage See listing, free, closed Mondays; one source, local city museum.

review.name: Pu'an Lighthouse
review.case: For: coastal landmark photo stop. Against: short stop, effectively part of Dongsha Fishing Village.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage names the lighthouse; one source; it sits at Dongsha village (300 m from it).

review.name: Jishan Island
review.case: For: ferry-served island day out. Against: one source, thin detail.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage lists this 3A island for seafood and scenery; no second counted source found.

review.name: Xuanmen Bay National Wetland Park
review.case: For: real wildlife draw in winter. Against: seasonal, adjacent to the agricultural park.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage: black-headed gull and black-faced spoonbill wintering habitat; one source.

review.name: Yuhuan Xuanmen Bay Sightseeing Agricultural Park
review.case: For: 4A, paid attraction. Against: farm-picking park, overlaps the wetland park.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage names it a 4A park, one of east China's largest sightseeing farms, ticket 35 yuan; one source.

review.name: Longxi Animation Flower Valley
review.case: For: permanent family attraction. Against: commercial kids' park, thin source.
review.judge_reason: Wikivoyage lists this 3A kids' flower valley and dinosaur park; one source.

review.name: Sansuan Island
review.case: For: second-tier island a tourism board names. Against: one counted source, boat-only, thin detail.
review.judge_reason: China Daily 2021 islands feature: Wenling's southernmost inhabited island, tidal flats and camping; Trip adds black pebble beach, boat ~30 min. Sources: https://zhejiang.chinadaily.com.cn/etaizhou/2021-07/15/c_642977.htm

review.name: Coral Rock and Taozhu Geopark
review.case: For: guide-named geological sight. Against: overlaps Taozhu Ancient City and the geopark area, Coral Rock itself has one counted source.
review.judge_reason: travelchinaguide names Taozhu Provincial Scenic Area and Coral Rock; China Daily Taozhu page describes columnar volcanic rock, '13 islets' farmland and sea-eroded features in Linhai National Geopark. Sources: https://regional.chinadaily.com.cn/ezhejiang/etaizhou/2018-12/26/c_310712.htm

review.name: Jinshan Park
review.case: For: pagodas and hill views beside the old town. Against: counted source missing, part of the Jinshan scenic area with Longxing Temple.
review.judge_reason: Trip listings: Linhai hill park with the Three Towers (Wenfeng twin towers, Thousand Buddha Tower); no tourism-board source opened. Sources: Trip.com Jinshan Pagoda Group listing

review.name: Longxing Temple
review.case: For: historic working temple. Against: one counted source, overlaps Jinshan Park.
review.judge_reason: China Daily 'Some of most famous temples in Taizhou' names it: 1,300-year-old Linhai temple, birthplace of Japan's Tendai; Trip adds Thousand Buddha Tower. Sources: https://regional.chinadaily.com.cn/ezhejiang/etaizhou/2020-06/10/c_499284.htm

review.name: Yuhuan Shaddock Orchard
review.case: For: Yuhuan's famed wendan fruit. Against: seasonal, picking only, not a defined venue.
review.judge_reason: travelchinaguide lists a 'Shaddock Orchard' among other spots; no named place or visitor source found for it in English or Chinese; Yuhuan Wendan Festival is autumn only. Sources: travelchinaguide Taizhou

notes: Linhai, Tiantai, Wenling and Yuhuan are not proposed: no Wikivoyage page for Linhai/Tiantai/Wenling, and each has fewer than four coherent kept places. Tiantai sub-sights are in review.
